name: Giveaway
description: - Database-backed entrant list — winners are guaranteed to be drawn even if reactions are lost or rate-limited.
- Self-healing finalizer: if Discord errors mid-end, the bot retries until the winner is announced.
- On-startup catch-up: giveaways that ended while the bot was offline are resolved immediately.
- Native Discord countdown timestamps (no per-minute embed edits).
- Optional required role, bonus entries for roles, winner DMs, end-now, pause/resume, edit, and reroll-by-position.
author: slayinglooty
